headline: Isărescu's appeal for political stability
summary: Central bank governor Mugur Isărescu appealed to the governing coalition for political stability. He linked stability to economic corrections and investor confidence, according to Saptamana Financiara.
why: The National Bank of Romania sets the country's monetary policy, and its commentary on politics and fiscal stability influences investor sentiment toward Romanian assets.
